question: Does the paired CSF-minus-blood difference in the pro-inflammatory module arise from a shift in the mixture of cell states, or from a change within states? This is the composition rival a CSF-enriched Th17-lineage subset would produce, which a stratified contrast cannot address.
decision: Whether registered question A30 can describe a compartment-associated effector state in CSF CD4-lineage T cells, or must record the Wp-M3 elevation as an activation correlate or a mixture shift.
strongest_rival: Local activation. CSF T cells are more activated than blood T cells, the declared activation set exceeds its own matched null in the same direction, and in blood it correlates with every module at Spearman -0.61 to -0.87. A second rival is composition: a CSF-enriched Th17-lineage subset would raise an effector module through mixture without any cell changing state.
discriminator: Cluster the cells de novo from genes outside both modules and outside the activation panel, so neither the endpoint nor the stratifier can define the states, then split each donor's paired difference by the symmetric Kitagawa identity. A composition term carrying the difference indicates a mixture shift; a within term carrying it indicates cells differing at matched state.
exposure_record: The UNSTRATIFIED result this re-tests is fully exposed: Wp-M3's paired tissue contrast is read and reported, and A30 was registered on the strength of it. The STRATIFIED values, the decomposition terms and the de novo cell states are unexposed: no variant of this computation has been executed, inside or outside the governed runner, and no dry run was performed precisely because the A30 development plan fixes the stratification before any stratified value is inspected. The activation panel was selected before execution by removing module members from a candidate list; CD40LG was dropped on that rule and the Wp-R4 panel was rejected because it contains ZFP36, a pro-regulatory module gene. Exclusion was deliberately not extended to the Table S3 differential-expression universe, which covers 11,364 genes and is not this analysis's endpoint; that decision was taken before execution and is recorded because it is a judgement call a reviewer may dispute. Superseding note: v1 of this contract executed on 5 October 2026 and its primary-family values were read before this amendment was written. Those values are therefore EXPOSED for v2. They are unaffected in construction by either defect, but the random-set null draw order depends on the set of distinct mapped sizes, which the Table S5 correction changes, so v2's empirical p values will differ slightly from v1's and both are reported rather than only the later one. A first invocation of this entrypoint failed at import with a SyntaxError (a __future__ import placed after the thread-pinning block) and produced no output of any kind; its empty run directory was removed and the file corrected. No value was computed or read, so nothing about outcome exposure changes.
biological_unit: Donor, paired. Ten donors contribute both compartments; cells are observations within donor.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells are nested in unit, unit in donor, and the two compartments of a donor are paired, which the contrast respects by differencing within donor. Strata are cut on a score computed from the same cells, so strata are not independent samples. The analysis reuses the GSE138266 deposit already analysed by Wp-R4 and by Schafflick et al. 2020; it shares one evidence lineage with both and is never independent replication.
population_and_selection: CD4-lineage T cells recovered under the Wp-R4 v2 gate, QC and deposit fixes, unchanged: a 500-UMI floor on the one library deposited unfiltered at 737,280 barcodes, and a summed panel-signal lineage comparison rather than hard-zero exclusion. The run asserts that per-unit cell recovery is identical to Wp-R4 v2 and fails otherwise, so the stratification attaches to the analysed cells. A unit enters a stratum only with at least 50 cells there, and a donor enters a stratum only when both of its units clear that floor; units and donors lost at the floor are reported per stratum.
contrast: Per activation stratum, the paired CSF-minus-blood difference of donor-level mean score across the donors that stratum supports.
endpoint: Per donor and module arm: total paired difference, composition term, within-state term and the identity residual, which must be zero. Plus the per-state cell composition of each compartment.
methods: Scoring is the Wp-R4 v2 convention unchanged: CP10K, log1p, pooled z-scaling across all cells, mean signed z over mapped genes. Strata are three tertiles of the disjoint activation score cut on global quantiles, so a low-activation CSF cell is compared against a low-activation blood cell rather than against its own compartment's distribution. Null draws are shared across strata for gene sets of equal mapped size and aggregated to the per-stratum paired median inside the draw loop. The decomposition is the symmetric Kitagawa identity, whose residual is reported per donor and must be zero. De novo states are Leiden at resolution 1.0 on 2,000 highly variable genes selected from genes outside both modules and outside the activation panel, 30 PCs, seed 20261005.
missingness_and_exclusions: Genes absent from the shared feature space are dropped and the mapped count reported per score. Units below 20 cells do not enter at all, as in Wp-R4 v2. Donors with only one compartment contribute to no paired contrast.
multiplicity: No test is performed. The decomposition is an exact algebraic split of an already reported quantity, summarised by its median across donors and by how many donors share the sign.
precision_basis: Ten paired donors with no age, sex, treatment or disease-duration field. A stratified contrast has less power than the unstratified one it checks, so a null is precision-limited by construction and no effect margin is nominated.
interpretation_limit: Donor-level module scores are RNA, not protein, secretion or regulatory function, and the modules are mouse-derived and transported by symbol identity. A compartment association is not evidence that the compartment caused the state. Stratifying on activation addresses the activation rival only: residency and recirculation are not addressed by any output here, because that needs shared-clone comparison across compartments which this deposit cannot supply. A failure to separate the hypotheses is precision-limited, never evidence of absence.
stop_rule: Report both module arms and both terms for every donor, with the identity residual, whichever way the split falls. Do not change the clustering resolution, the number of principal components, the gene selection or the seed after seeing a term. If the composition term carries the paired difference, A30 records a mixture shift rather than a compartment-imposed state.
amendment_reason: Discharges the de novo cell-state decomposition that wp_a30_activation_stratified_v2 declared and recorded as not executed, because the parallel k-nearest-neighbour backend raises PermissionError WinError 5 in this sandbox. The fix is an environment one: exact scikit-learn neighbours with every thread pool pinned to a single worker, verified at full scale before the contract was frozen. No question, module, gene set, cluster parameter or stop rule changes; the stratified contrast is not recomputed and v2 remains the result of record for it.
